Goal: HOME TAB - Has unique Left Navigation vs. Project Tab

There is still a lot of weird UI issues when I access the Home-TAB , it needs to swap to its own left navigation menu where global session-manager wide options are controlled. The individual 'Project'-Tabs will have the current menu. We will need to rework the left-navigation item's content to be Global-Only (in the Home-Tab) to "Project/Local"-only in the Project-Tabs
Both explore agents are running in the background — I'll wait for their results before scoping the `/develop` PRD chain for this nav rework.

there is currentlt an EPIC in proposed that is not clear where it came from, my guess is that your session didn't receive feedback from teh scheduller session and the feedback got created as an EPIC which is wrong?

Confirmed — this is **not** a mis-routed feedback signal from my session. It's the documented `rcaFeedbackHook.cjs` mechanism working exactly as designed (per this repo's CLAUDE.md: *"An agent that wants work done files a proposed Epic... The in-app producer is `lib/rcaFeedbackHook.cjs` — a failed PRD files a proposal"*).

**What actually happened, traced from the data:**

1. `session-manager-operations/prompt-sessions/active-index.json` has one `proposed` Epic: `prd-894-home-global-controls-dashboard-needs-rev-b37bedf2`, `tag: "bug"`, `source: "scheduler-rca"`.
2. Its `openingPrompt` is an auto-generated RCA report: job `894-home-global-controls-dashboard` was parked in `needs_review` at `2026-08-01T15:51:55Z` with verdict `pass_no_commit` — "PASS sentinel but no commit landed."
3. Root cause: PRD 894's source file (`scheduler/epics/two-face-leftnav-.../prds/894-home-global-controls-dashboard.md`) is **stale** — the feature it asked for (the Global Controls dashboard section) was already built and committed earlier that same morning (`8b61462`, `2cf02e5`, `23469ff`), and a fix-PRD for its test-coverage gaps already ran and archived at `08:32` (`prds-archived/894-fix-home-global-controls-dashboard.md`).
4. Something re-ran the original 894 PRD again later (`15:50`). Since the work was already done, the executor correctly made no change and exited PASS — but with zero commit, which the verifier can't distinguish from "did nothing wrong," so it parks as `needs_review` and the RCA hook auto-files a bug proposal. The hook's own log text even says the fix directly: *"Archive the PRD into `prds-archived/` instead of re-queuing or re-running it."*

**Not a mistake to worry about** — the proposed Epic itself is correct, expected behavior (this replaced the old feedback-folder pipeline). The actual loose end is that **`894-home-global-controls-dashboard.md` is still sitting active** in `scheduler/epics/.../prds/` instead of archived, so it can get re-triggered again. I didn't move it myself — `scheduler/` is single-writer-owned by the scheduler surface (not something I should hand-edit via `mv`) — but you can clear this cleanly from the Scheduler tab's archive action, or by approving the proposed Epic (which will just note "already shipped, archive the stale PRD" and close itself).

**Recommendation:** approve-and-let-run the proposed Epic — its own diagnosis will just archive the stale PRD file, which is the correct, safe fix.

what is wrong was the an EPIC was created without a trace of where it came from , we need to edpand the EPIC schema to capture this if we are going to allow auto-creation. This must not be an easy go to action as EPIC must be of distict topic and vluae, otherwise it should be a subwork/PRD and continueatin of another EPIC

## Queued: 4-PRD chain for Epic provenance + distinctness gate

All under this Epic (`psess-msaja8vp-1`), `cwd: /home/bilko/Projects/session-manager`:

| NN | Slug | Depends on | ETA | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **902** | `epic-source-provenance-schema` | — | ~15m | Adds `source?: EpicSource` to `PromptSession` (structured `producer`/`prdSlug`/`runId`/`sourceTabId`), threads it through `ensureEpic()`, extends the existing `auditLog.cjs` `epic_mint` event (reused, not duplicated) with the same producer info, updates the README schema block. |
| **903** | `epic-distinctness-gate` | 902 | ~25m | New `findJoinableEpic()` in `epicMint.cjs`: prefers an explicit known origin Epic, else Jaccard token-similarity (≥0.35) against open Epics' `goalText` before minting a new one. `forceNewEpic:true` escape hatch. This is the actual "don't make new-Epic the easy default" gate you asked for. |
| **904** | `epic-source-wire-rca-hook` | 903 | ~15m | The concrete fix for what you found: `rcaFeedbackHook.cjs` currently only does `reuseByGoal` on a synthesized, run-unique title (guaranteed to never match), so it always mints a disconnected Epic. Wires it to prefer `job.epicId` — the failing PRD's own originating Epic — and tags `source: {producer:'rca-hook', prdSlug, runId}`. |
| **905** | `epic-source-wire-remaining-producers` | 903 | ~20m | Same `source` tagging for the other 3 producers: `propose-epic.cjs`, `watchdogHelpers.cjs` (feedback sweep), `scheduler.cjs`'s PRD-dispatch join. |

Root cause confirmed while scoping: the RCA hook never had a mechanism to reconnect to the Epic its failing PRD already belonged to (`job.epicId` exists on every job record but was never passed in) — PRD 904 closes exactly that gap.

Not yet started: watching these run and verifying against AC. Given the one-shot/no-background-polling constraint on this turn, I'm not launching a 30-min tracking loop now — check the Scheduler tab or re-invoke `/develop`'s tracking phase to follow these to completion.
